update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Probe interval in seconds. It must be long enough for the configured timeout and retry budget.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: Recheck interval in seconds for a configured job whose initial S3 check failed. Zero disables retries.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Absolute HTTP(S) base endpoint of the S3-compatible service, without a path, query, or credentials.

region.title: Region
region.description: S3 signing region, for example us-east-1.

bucket.title: Dedicated probe bucket
bucket.description: Unversioned bucket reserved for this probe. Bucket versioning must be disabled and the bucket must not contain unrelated data.

prefix.title: Probe prefix
prefix.description: Dedicated key prefix, ending with a slash and used only by this collector.

access_key_id.title: Access key ID
access_key_id.description: Static S3 access key ID. Use a Netdata secret reference in configuration files.

secret_access_key.title: Secret access key
secret_access_key.description: Static S3 secret access key. Use a Netdata secret reference in configuration files.

path_style.title: Path-style addressing
path_style.description: Place the bucket in the URL path, as used by Ceph RGW and many S3-compatible services. Disable it for AWS S3 virtual-host addressing.

max_retries.title: Maximum retries
max_retries.description: Additional attempts allowed per S3 operation. Zero sends one attempt; the maximum is two.

latency_threshold_ms.title: Latency objective
latency_threshold_ms.description: Successful stage duration in milliseconds that raises the silent latency alert. Zero disables the policy.

timeout.title: HTTP timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for one HTTP attempt.

not_follow_redirects.title: Reject redirects
not_follow_redirects.description: Reject endpoint redirects so signed requests cannot be resent to an unconfigured origin.

vnode.title: Vnode
vnode.description: Associate this data collection job with a configured Virtual Node.

proxy_url.title: Proxy URL
proxy_url.description: HTTP proxy URL. An empty value uses the standard proxy environment variables.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate and hostname verification. This is insecure.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Absolute path to a CA bundle.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Absolute path to a client certificate.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Absolute path to a client private key.

mode.title: Probe mode
mode.description: Run the original single-endpoint lifecycle, or verify one explicit source-to-destination replication direction.

source_site.title: Source site label
source_site.description: Bounded operator label for the source site. Required in multisite mode.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Explicit destination endpoint, credentials, bucket, prefix, and transport settings. Required in multisite mode; no other site is probed automatically.

site.title: Destination site label
site.description: Bounded operator label for the destination site.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Absolute HTTP(S) S3 base endpoint without a path, query, or credentials.

region.title: Region
region.description: S3 signing region for the destination.

bucket.title: Dedicated destination bucket
bucket.description: Unversioned destination bucket reserved for this directional probe.

prefix.title: Destination probe prefix
prefix.description: Dedicated destination key prefix ending with a slash.

access_key_id.title: Destination access key ID
access_key_id.description: Static destination S3 access key ID. Use a Netdata secret reference in configuration files.

secret_access_key.title: Destination secret access key
secret_access_key.description: Static destination S3 secret access key. Use a Netdata secret reference in configuration files.

session_token.title: Destination session token
session_token.description: Optional static destination S3 session token.

path_style.title: Destination path-style addressing
path_style.description: Place the destination bucket in the URL path, as used by Ceph RGW. Disable it for virtual-host addressing.

timeout.title: Destination HTTP timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for one destination HTTP attempt.

not_follow_redirects.title: Reject destination redirects
not_follow_redirects.description: Reject destination redirects so signed requests cannot be resent to an unconfigured origin.

proxy_url.title: Destination proxy URL
proxy_url.description: HTTP proxy URL for the destination; empty uses standard proxy environment variables.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip destination TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip destination certificate and hostname verification. This is insecure.

tls_ca.title: Destination TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Absolute path to a destination CA bundle.

tls_cert.title: Destination TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Absolute path to a destination client certificate.

tls_key.title: Destination TLS key
tls_key.description: Absolute path to a destination client private key.

rpo_threshold_ms.title: Replication RPO
rpo_threshold_ms.description: Source-write to destination-visibility duration in milliseconds that raises the silent RPO alert. It must be at least update_every because visibility is polled once per cycle.

replication_timeout_ms.title: Replication polling deadline
replication_timeout_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds from source write to destination visibility before the directional probe is abandoned and cleaned up.

delete_threshold_ms.title: Delete propagation objective
delete_threshold_ms.description: Source-delete to destination-disappearance duration in milliseconds that raises the silent policy alert. It must be at least update_every because disappearance is polled once per cycle.

delete_timeout_ms.title: Delete polling deadline
delete_timeout_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds from source delete to destination disappearance before the destination copy is removed explicitly.

verify_delete.title: Verify delete propagation
verify_delete.description: Wait for destination disappearance after deleting the source object before explicit destination cleanup.
